## Whether you’re a team of 1 or 1,000, Fathom’s got your back

## Shared visibility. Smarter execution.

Fathom gives teams a shared source of truth across every customer conversation, internal sync, and strategy call – so decisions are visible, follow-through is consistent, and nothing gets lost between meetings.

Search conversations, spot patterns, and keep work moving without the manual work.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c0a49791530f54cd55_0d860dfc5bc7a426568ad59993d5b2ef_T-I_1.svg)

Automatic notes, summaries, and updates reduce follow-ups and admin across the team.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c053b0828f2b9f99a7_e9181d8ecfbc8b4d779a3fc73073820e_T-I_2.svg)

Turn conversations into clear next steps that move deals and projects forward.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c017fb51b97deba785_ae33610220b7057efef8dbe525b0b6a2_T_3.svg)

Keep decisions, commitments, and customer signals visible across meetings and teams.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c02e9680d1f39ac969_c451af2764a162cb16ff4c2abed8a432_T_4.svg)

Spot patterns, risks, and opportunities across conversations before they become problems.

Fully present.

Always prepared.

Fathom captures every detail of your meetings so you can stay present, ask better questions, and never worry about missing something important.

Get clear summaries, searchable transcripts, and instant follow-ups without scrambling to take notes or recap the call.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c0a49791530f54cd55_0d860dfc5bc7a426568ad59993d5b2ef_T-I_1.svg)

Stay engaged, ask better questions and build stronger relationships without worrying about capturing every detail.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6899da9beccbdbe92be49b5d/699cb8c0ff4aaf99548a20e4_9744d9e81f0ea3ed211a539b16c9fdec_I_4.svg)

Ask Fathom questions across past conversations and instantly surface key insights and clarity.

### Clarity

Unforgettable meetings...quite literally

Shockingly accurate transcripts, instant summaries, and action items with consistent quality across every call – delivered straight to your inbox, like magic.

### Momentum

Eliminate overhead & maximize productivity

'Ask Fathom' anything about your meetings – a place to search everything, and get customizable AI summaries tailored to your team's workflow and priorities so you spend less time searching and more time doing.

### Ease
